Extract Power Sale Agreement providing for the tariff of power supply

## BUYER-BUYING ENTITY PSA

## ARTICLE 5: APPLICABLE TARIFF

1. 1.1 From SCD and subject to the provision of the Article 6.7, the Buying Entity shall pay the
2. fixed tariff of Rs. 2.42/kWh plus trading margin of Rs. 0.07/ kWh for the entire term of
3. this agreement.
5. 1.2 Not used
7. 1.3 Benefits on account of any reduction in tariff as per provisions of SECI-SPD PPA, shall be
8. passed on to the Buying Entity.
10. 1.4 As per provisions of the PPA, the SPDs are permitted for full commissioning as well as
11. part commissioning of the Project even prior to the SCD. In cases of early part-
12. commissioning, till the achievement of full commissioning or SCD, whichever is earlier,
13. the Buying Entityshall purchase the generation till SCD, at 75% (seventy-five per cent)
14. of the tariff as mentioned in the Article 5.1.1 plus Trading Margin of Rs 0.07/kWh,
15. (Seven Paisa per kWh). In case of full commissioning of the Project(s) prior to SCD,
16. Buying Entityshall purchase the power at tariff as per article 5.1.1 plus Trading Margin
17. of Rs 0.07/kWh, (Seven Paisa per kWh).
19. 1.5 Not Used
21. 1.6 Not used
23. 1.7 Subsequent to grant of connectivity, in case there is a delay in grant/operationalization
24. of LTA by the CTU and/or there is a delay in readiness of the ISTS substation at the
25. Delivery Point, including readiness of the power evacuation and transmission
26. infrastructure of the ISTS network until SCD of the Project, and it is established that:
27. (i) The SPD has complied with the complete application formalities as per RfS,
28. (ii) The SPD has adhered to the applicable Procedure in this regard as notified
29. by the CERC/CTU, and
30. (iii) The delay in grant of connectivity/LTA by the CTU and/or delay in readiness of the
31. ISTS substation at the Delivery Point, including readiness of the power evacuation
32. and transmission infrastructure of the ISTS network, is a factor attributable to the
33. CTU/transmission licensee and is beyond the control of the SPD;
35. The above shall be treated as delays beyond the control of the SPD and SCD shall
36. be extended for such Projects upto 15 days subsequent to the readiness of the
